english.note: Use this for an unwanted attempt to start talking to or flirt with someone, especially in a casual spoken context.

exampleSentences.english: He made an advance on a girl at the bar.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢喺酒吧度同個女仔搭訕。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 zau2 baa1 dou6 tung4 go3 neoi5 zai2 daap3 saan3

english.note: Use this for a flirtatious or sexual approach, rather than for an ordinary attempt to start a conversation.

exampleSentences.english: They made a pass at a girl in the bar and even tried to ask her out.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢喺酒吧同個女仔搭訕，仲想約人出去。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 zau2 baa1 tung4 go3 neoi5 zai2 daap3 saan3 zung6 soeng2 joek3 jan4 ceot1 heoi3
